description:
Syncing, backing up, and sharing your files in total privacy couldn’t be easier.
With Internxt Drive we focus on user-friendly encrypted storage with military-grade
encryption, so only you have control over your files and data.


#### Bug fixes:
• Improved performance when trying to upload large amounts of files at one
• Fixed bug for empty files that would open file size limit modal
• Improved performance on backups
• Improved sync performance
• context menu registration for w10
• Properly add original file modification and creation time
• if the system generates a phantom folder, we delete it when the app restarts. 
• http status 502 is now retriable

#### Whats new:

• Mail Bridge for Windows Released
